old: The system will also retain the interval from opening-cue onset to selection, preserving the opening instruction and subsequent search within a broader timing measure. This record permits examination of differences in opening-clip duration across voices, while active completion time remains the primary outcome.
new: The system will also retain the broader interval from opening-cue onset to selection. This measure includes the opening instruction, whose duration may differ across voices, while active completion time remains the primary outcome.
reason: The revision implies that this interval measures clip-duration differences, but it does not. The original reason was that clip duration differs across voices, which is why the broader interval is kept. The phrase "preserving the opening instruction ... within a broader timing measure" is also awkward.
claude_new: The system will also retain the broader interval from opening-cue onset to selection, which includes the time spent receiving the opening instruction. Because prepared opening clips can differ in duration across voices, this record remains informative, although active completion time is the primary outcome.
